metadata.question: Does the built-up area east of the Nile River in Cairo increase from July 1984 to September 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Cairo, Egypt, east of the Nile River - Time periods: July 1984 and September 2019 - Collections: Landsat 5 for 1984, Landsat 8 for 2019 - Need to define geometry for "east of Nile in Cairo" 2. Masking strategy: - Cloud masking is important for accurate built-up area detection - Use QA bands for both Landsat 5 and 8 - Built-up areas can be detected using NDBI (Normalized Difference Built-up Index) or urban indices 3. Logic: - Valid Zero: If built-up area is legitimately 0 or decreases, answer B - If collections are empty: C1 - If valid pixels are 0 after masking: C2 - If calculation returns None/NaN: C3 - If built-up area increases: A ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry - East of Nile in Cairo // Cairo center approximately at (31.2357, 30.0444) // Create a polygon east of the Nile (longitude > 31.25) const cairo_east = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[31.25, 30.15], [31.50, 30.15], [31.50, 29.90], [31.25, 29.90], [31.25, 30.15]] ]); // 2. Data Acquisition for 1984 (Landsat 5) const col1984 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(cairo_east) .filterDate('1984-07-01', '1984-07-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const size1984 = col1984.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1984 Images found: ${size1984}`); if (size1984 === 0) { console.log("No Landsat 5 data for July 1984."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Data Acquisition for 2019 (Landsat 8) const col2019 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(cairo_east) .filterDate('2019-09-01', '2019-09-30') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const size2019 = col2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images found: ${size2019}`); if (size2019 === 0) { console.log("No Landsat 8 data for September 2019."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 4. Cloud masking function for Landsat 5 function maskL5sr(image) { const qaMask = image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(parseInt('11111', 2)).eq(0); return image.updateMask(qaMask).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); } // 5. Cloud masking function for Landsat 8 function maskL8sr(image) { const qaMask = image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(parseInt('11111', 2)).eq(0); return image.updateMask(qaMask).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); } // 6. Calculate NDBI (Normalized Difference Built-up Index) // NDBI = (SWIR - NIR) / (SWIR + NIR) const img1984 = col1984.map(maskL5sr).median(); const ndbi1984 = img1984.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDBI'); const img2019 = col2019.map(maskL8sr).median(); const ndbi2019 = img2019.normalizedDifference(['SR_B6', 'SR_B5']).rename('NDBI'); // 7. Check valid pixels const count1984 = ndbi1984.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: cairo_east, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDBI').getInfo(); const count2019 = ndbi2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: cairo_east, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDBI').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels 1984: ${count1984}, 2019: ${count2019}`); if (count1984 === 0 || count2019 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 8. Calculate built-up area (pixels with NDBI > 0) const builtup1984 = ndbi1984.gt(0); const builtup2019 = ndbi2019.gt(0); const area1984 = builtup1984.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: cairo_east, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDBI').getInfo(); const area2019 = builtup2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: cairo_east, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDBI').getInfo(); console.log(`Built-up pixels 1984: ${area1984}`); console.log(`Built-up pixels 2019: ${area2019}`); // 9. Validation and Final Answer if (area1984 === null || area2019 === null || isNaN(area1984) || isNaN(area2019)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid result."); console.log("C3"); return; } const increase = area2019 - area1984; console.log(`Change in built-up pixels: ${increase} (${((increase/area1984)*100).toFixed(1)}%)`); if (area2019 > area1984) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
